topics.title: Your account
topics.body: Create an account, confirm your email, and sign in to access your personal marketplace. Use the password recovery link if you lose access.

topics.title: Marketplace
topics.body: Browse categories and review the price, quantity, and duration of each item. Purchases use portal credits and are delivered to your game account.

topics.title: Player trading
topics.body: List game gold for portal credits or buy an existing offer. Your character must be offline and the game storage must already be initialized.

topics.title: Payments
topics.body: Select a payment method and review its rate and bonus before continuing. Credits appear after the provider confirms the payment.

topics.title: Rankings
topics.body: Compare player levels, competitive results, and guild achievements. Rankings refresh periodically and never expose private account information.
